title: AGENTS.md
text: model never emits code package never calls eval()/parse() model output. Tool arguments plain data validated genui_dispatch() (pure, Shiny/LLM) anything renders. Every insertUI()/removeUI() passes session = explicitly, component servers run shiny::withReactiveDomain(session, ...): tool calls fire inside ellmer’s async promise chains ambient reactive domain unreliable. Instance ids (c1, c2, …) assigned deterministically never reused. Trace entries plain JSON-able lists; embedded input state intentionally never recorded (replay restores defaults). update_component re-instantiates module inside instance’s stable shell (position, ids); observer handles live registry destroyed update/remove. Output render functions can’t unregistered — replaced update, left suspended remove. Errors tool handling must propagate conditions (never crash session): ellmer converts tool errors via conditionMessage(), therefore model-facing text — make actionable (name bad value, list valid ones). One ellmer Chat per Shiny session. Component descriptions inst/prompts/system.md product surface; edit care.

title: AGENTS.md
text: cli: message interpolating two vectors makes {?s} fail “Multiple quantities pluralization” — prefix {cli::qty(length(x))}. Wrappers around cli_abort() must thread .envir = parent.frame() (call argument) interpolation happens wrong frame. Never let model-supplied text reach cli/glue interpolator (may contain braces JSON): sprintf() first, interpolate result single value. R6::R6Class requires unique names across public + private + active combined. whisker treats "" truthy; pass NULL suppress template section. ellmer types S7: class vectors look like c("ellmer::TypeEnum", "ellmer::Type", "S7_object"); read properties attr(x, "values", exact = TRUE) etc. ellmer::tool() requires function’s formals exactly match declared arguments (generate formals rlang::new_function() + rlang::pairlist2()). chat_openai(api_key = ) deprecated; use credentials = function() list(api_key = ...) tests. shiny::MockShinySession implements sendInsertUI/sendRemoveUI warning -ops: full engine paths run fine testServer — wrap calls suppressWarnings(). shinychat DOM (0.4.x): messages render div.shiny-chat-messages inside <shiny-chat-container id="..."> (class selector, element); user input arrives input$<id>_user_input, cancel input$<id>_cancel. Progressive rendering timing: components land canvas model still streaming narration. assertion chat “quiet” must first wait -flight stream finish. shinytest2 refuses run without NOT_CRAN=true (scripts may Sys.setenv ).

title: shinygenui design
text: Declarative, catalog-constrained generative UI Shiny. app developer defines finite catalog components; end users chat LLM composes, updates, removes instances components canvas, streamed progressively plain Shiny app. R/Shiny analogue Vercel’s json-render Google’s A2UI, narrowed one language, one framework, one deployment story.

title: shinygenui design
text: Pure core (Shiny, LLM): genui_component(), genui_catalog(), genui_dispatch(), argument validation ellmer types. Fully unit tested hand-built fake tool calls. Session state: GenuiRegistry (R6). Holds instances (id, component name, current args, parent id, observer handles, public-reactives hook), id counter, ordered trace. State transitions ; DOM. Shiny executor: turns dispatch plans insertUI() / removeUI() calls module-server instantiations, always explicit session. LLM wiring: catalog -> ellmer::tool() compilation, built-lifecycle tools, prompt assembly (whisker template), shinychat streaming loop. Objects: R6 stateful classes (GenuiRegistry), plain S3 lists declarative data (genui_component, genui_catalog, plans, trace entries), ellmer’s S7 ContentToolResult tool results — mirroring querychat’s split.

title: shinygenui design
text: Errors anywhere inside tool fn (dispatch validation, check() hook, rendering) propagate ordinary R conditions; ellmer’s tool invoker catches returns ContentToolResult(error = ...) model, self-corrects next turn. Shiny session never crashes; worst case ugly dashboard. model never emits R code package never calls eval()/parse() model output — arguments data, interpreted developer-written component functions. ellmer invokes tools assistant turn requested completes, loops follow-turn. validated call inserts UI immediate = TRUE inside async chain, components pop onto canvas mid-conversation surrounding chat_append() stream still open — progressive rendering without custom transport.
code: user message --- shinychat --> chat$stream_async(stream = "content")  [ExtendedTask]   --> model streams narrative text --> chat_append() renders it   --> model emits tool call (schema-validated args, JSON on the wire only)         --> compiled tool fn: normalize to a genui_call               --> genui_dispatch(catalog, call, state)  [pure]                     validates: component exists, ids exist, args well-typed,                     semantic check() hook passes -> returns a *plan*                     (create/update/remove/clear + resolved id, merged args,                     target selector) or signals a classed genui error               --> registry records the transition + appends trace entry               --> executor: insertUI(immediate = TRUE, session = session),                     withReactiveDomain(session, component$server(id, args, data))         --> tool returns ContentToolResult(value = "Created c1 (scatter_plot)",               extra = display metadata for shinychat's tool display)   --> model sees the instance id, continues narrating / calling tools

title: shinygenui design
text: Every instance gets stable id c1, c2, ... (counter lives registry) renders inside stable shell div(id = ns("shell-c1")) appended canvas div(id = ns("canvas")). component’s module id instance id, scoped genui module’s namespace, embedded inputs collision-free interaction re-renders Shiny speed zero LLM round trips. create: dispatch assigns next id; executor inserts shell canvas (container instance’s slot parent_id given) runs component’s server(id, args, data) module session. update: update_component(id, args) — dispatch merges partial args current args (modifyList()), re-validates, executor destroys instance’s observers, empties shell (removeUI children), re-instantiates UI + server merged args. shell never moves, position preserved flicker. v0.1 embedded input state resets defaults update (module re-instantiated); snapshot/restore input values across updates explicitly future work. remove / clear: destroy observers (children first containers), removeUI() shell(s). Observer teardown contract: component server function returns moduleServer result; observers included returned value (single observer nested list) collected registry $destroy()ed update/remove. returned reactives element stored keyed instance id — v0.2 hook cross-component reactivity (single blessed filtered-data channel, arbitrary pub/sub); nothing reads v0.1. Known Shiny limitation: output render functions truly unregistered. update reuse ids, re-registration replaces ; remove, orphaned outputs stay suspended bound DOM element, acceptable.

title: shinygenui design
text: catalog entry compiles ellmer::tool() whose formals generated declared arg names (ellmer requires formals ↔︎ arguments match). Catalogs may built per session inside server function, arg types can enumerate live facts (e.g. dataset columns type_enum values) — hallucinated column schema violation model must correct. Three built-ins ride alongside: update_component, remove_component, clear_canvas. ellmer express per-component union schemas, update_component takes args JSON object string; parsed jsonlite (data, never code) validated server-side component’s declared types (enum membership, scalar/array kinds) — guardrail, enforced dispatch instead provider. Reserved arg names: parent_id (auto-added every component catalog contains containers), id.

title: shinygenui design
text: Every validated call appends list(op, id, component, args) ordered trace (plain JSON-able lists, environments). Replay fold: fresh registry, dispatch + execute entry exact pipeline LLM path uses — genui_replay(trace, catalog, target) rebuilds canvas LLM configured. Embedded input state ephemeral decision: never recorded, replay restores defaults. genui_trace() exposes trace reactive read.

title: shinygenui design
text: Tool fns fire inside promise chains ambient reactive domain unreliable: every tool closes session passes explicitly insertUI()/removeUI(); component servers run inside withReactiveDomain(session, ...) moduleServer() binds correctly. streaming loop shiny::ExtendedTask (stream_async -> promise -> chat_append), sessions never block; ellmer::stream_controller() backs cancel button. data reactive passed component servers; dispatch-time consumers (check() hooks, replay) receive isolated current value, keeping core pure. genui_server(id, ...) module; optional shinychat wiring (chat_id) resolves caller’s session, since developer places chat_ui() alongside genui_canvas() call site. chat_id = NULL developers run loop; registered tools work regardless close right session. Chat object must created per session (document loudly); sharing one across sessions cross-wire tool closures.

title: shinygenui design
text: Emission tool calls ; restricted R DSL M5 stretch, v0.1. Layout chat + canvas; inline--chat rendering M5 stretch. Embedded interactive inputs v0.1; cross-component reactive wiring (registry keeps hook described ). Embedded input state never trace; replay restores defaults. Provider-agnostic via ellmer; examples default chat_anthropic().

title: shinygenui design
text: update_component become per-component update_<name> tools (full provider-side schema enforcement, n tools) catalogs grow? v0.1 ships single built-server-side validation. modifyList() drops keys JSON null — currently “reset arg default”; semantics want promise? Canvas layout: v0.1 uses simple responsive CSS grid optional per-component width hint; real layout negotiation (model-chosen spans) may deserve layout arg later. Concurrency: one -flight stream per session assumed; shinychat’s input gating enforces practice, nothing structural prevents developer invoking two streams whose tool calls interleave.

title: shinygenui
text: Three pieces work: genui_canvas("canvas") container components land . genui_catalog() collects components model may use — bslib starter pack: value box, markdown card, data table, scatter plot, histogram. genui_server() compiles catalog tools, registers (plus built-lifecycle tools) ellmer Chat, installs system prompt, runs chat loop shinychat::chat_ui() placed sidebar. ellmer provider works: swap ellmer::chat_anthropic() ellmer::chat_openai(), ellmer::chat_ollama(), . Create Chat inside server function — one per session — tool closures conversation history never shared users.
code: library(shiny) library(bslib)  ui <- page_sidebar(   title = "mtcars explorer",   sidebar = sidebar(width = 380, shinychat::chat_ui("chat", height = "100%")),   genui_canvas("canvas") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   catalog <- genui_catalog(genui_components_bslib(data = mtcars))    genui_server(     "canvas",     catalog = catalog,     chat = ellmer::chat_anthropic(),     data = reactive(mtcars),     chat_id = "chat",     greeting = "Ask me about the mtcars data.",     system_prompt = genui_prompt(       catalog,       context = "The data is R's built-in mtcars dataset."     )   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: shinygenui
text: component couples model-facing schema rendering code: name description product surface: exactly model reads deciding tool call. Write like documentation. args named list ellmer types. plain string shorthand ellmer::type_string(). catalogs ordinary R values, can build inside server function ground enums live facts: , column enumerates actual column names, hallucinated column rejected schema code ever runs. ui(id, args) returns htmltools tags. id instance’s module id; namespace embedded inputs outputs shiny::NS(id). server(id, args, data) optional wraps shiny::moduleServer(). data reactive passed genui_server(). Embedded inputs like slider real Shiny inputs wired instance’s module: dragging slider re-renders Shiny speed zero LLM traffic. module creates observers, return (alone list) can destroyed instance updated removed. check(args, data) runs schema validation current data value. Return NULL accept string reject; string becomes tool error model reads.
code: histogram <- genui_component(   name = "histogram",   description = "A histogram of one numeric column with a bin-count slider.",   args = list(     column = ellmer::type_enum(names(mtcars), "Column to plot."),     bins = ellmer::type_integer("Initial number of bins.", required = FALSE)   ),   ui = function(id, args) {     ns <- shiny::NS(id)     bslib::card(       shiny::plotOutput(ns("plot")),       shiny::sliderInput(ns("bins"), "Bins", 5, 60, args$bins %||% 30)     )   },   server = function(id, args, data) {     shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {       output$plot <- shiny::renderPlot({         hist(data()[[args$column]], breaks = input$bins)       })     })   },   check = function(args, data) {     if (!is.numeric(data[[args$column]])) {       paste0("Column \"", args$column, "\" is not numeric.")     }   } )

title: shinygenui
text: Every created instance gets stable id (c1, c2, …) returned model tool result. Alongside catalog, four built-tools always registered: update_component(id, args) merges partial arguments current ones, re-validates, re-instantiates module inside instance’s stable shell — canvas position, flicker. module restarts, embedded input state resets defaults update; snapshot restore across updates future work. remove_component(id) destroys instance (, containers, children). clear_canvas() empties canvas. get_canvas_state() read-: reports every instance arguments live values embedded inputs, model can see user adjusted acting. packaged system prompt (see genui_prompt()) instructs model narrate briefly chat placing visuals via tools, reuse update_component user refines existing view, prefer , dense components. Add app-specific grounding context argument — schema description, sample rows, business glossary. Raw data never put prompt unless put .

title: shinygenui
text: Every validated call appends ordered trace plain, serializable lists: spec record canvas. genui_trace() gives reactive read , genui_replay() folds saved trace validate--execute pipeline rebuild canvas — fresh session, LLM configured: Instance ids come back identical (id assignment deterministic ids never reused). Embedded input values intentionally recorded: replay restores components inputs defaults.
code: # in the session that built the canvas observe({   saveRDS(genui_trace(session)(), "canvas-trace.rds") })  # in a later session, no chat anywhere server <- function(input, output, session) {   genui_replay(     readRDS("canvas-trace.rds"),     catalog = catalog,     target = "canvas",     data = reactive(mtcars)   ) }

title: shinygenui
text: Every failure handling tool call — schema validation, check() hooks, rendering errors — becomes tool error model reads recovers . Failed creates roll back completely; failed updates leave existing instance untouched. Shiny session never crashes, worst case prompt injection ugly dashboard, code execution. Failures always written server log; set options(shinygenui.verbose = TRUE) also log successful canvas operations.

title: Define a generative UI component — genui_component
text: name Tool name model sees. snake_case string: lowercase letters, digits, underscores, starting letter. Must unique within catalog must collide built-lifecycle tools (update_component, remove_component, clear_canvas). description One three sentences telling model component shows use . model-facing documentation component, write well. args Named list ellmer type specifications (example ellmer::type_string(), ellmer::type_enum()) describing arguments model may supply. shorthand, plain string promoted ellmer::type_string(<string>). Argument names id parent_id reserved package. Catalogs often built inside Shiny server function enums can enumerate live facts, column names active dataset. ui function(id, args) returning htmltools::tag() (tag list). id fully namespaced module id instance; use shiny::NS(id) namespace embedded inputs outputs. args validated argument list. server Optional function(id, args, data) calls shiny::moduleServer() wire outputs embedded inputs. data reactive passed genui_server(). module creates observers, include module's return value (alone inside list) package can destroy instance updated removed. reactives element return value stored instance registry keyed instance id; nothing reads v0.1, hook cross-component reactivity later release. check Optional function(args, data) semantic validation beyond JSON schema. Return NULL args acceptable, string describing problem; string returned model tool error can self-correct. container TRUE, component can host child instances: ui must render element id shiny::NS(id, "slot"), components may target passing instance's id parent_id. width Layout hint canvas grid: "auto" (default), "wide", "full".

title: Assemble the system prompt from a catalog — genui_prompt
code: catalog <- genui_catalog(   genui_component(     name = "note_card",     description = "A card showing a short note.",     args = list(text = "The note text."),     ui = function(id, args) htmltools::p(args$text)   ) ) cat(genui_prompt(catalog, context = "The data is mtcars.")) #> You are the interface engine of a data application. The user sees two areas: #> this chat, and a canvas of visual components next to it. You answer questions #> by composing components on the canvas with the tools provided, while narrating #> briefly in chat. #>  #> ## How to work #>  #> - Place every visual, table, or computed summary on the canvas by calling the #>   matching component tool. Keep chat replies to one or two short sentences: #>   say what you placed and what it shows. Never duplicate in chat what a #>   component already shows, and never write out tables or ASCII charts in chat. #> - Prefer a few dense, well-chosen components over many small ones. Only add a #>   component when it helps answer the current question. #> - Every successful tool call returns the new instance's id, like "c1". Track #>   these ids: they are how you change the canvas later. #> - When the user refines a view that already exists (change a column, recolor, #>   retitle, and so on), call `update_component` with that instance's id and #>   only the arguments that change. Do not create a duplicate component. #> - When the user asks to remove something, call `remove_component` with its #>   id. Use `clear_canvas` only to start over. #> - If you are unsure what is currently on the canvas, or what values the user #>   set on a component's embedded inputs, call `get_canvas_state` before #>   acting on it. #> - If a tool call returns an error, read it carefully, fix the arguments, and #>   try again. Do not apologize at length and never fabricate a result for a #>   failed call. #> - Only the components listed below exist. If the user asks for something none #>   of them supports, say so briefly and offer the closest thing you can build. #>  #> ## Components #>  #> ### note_card #>  #> A card showing a short note. #>  #> Arguments: #> - `text` (string): The note text. #>  #> ## App context #>  #> The data is mtcars.

what: Server logic for a generative UI canvas — genui_server
title: Server logic for a generative UI canvas — genui_server
text: Wires genui_catalog() ellmer Chat: compiles every component schema-validated tool, registers built-lifecycle tools (update_component, remove_component, clear_canvas), installs assembled system prompt, executes validated tool calls genui_canvas() matching id. Components stream onto canvas progressively model emits tool calls; validation rendering failures returned model tool errors never crash session.

title: shinygenui: Generative UI for 'shiny' — shinygenui-package
text: Declarative, catalog-constrained generative user interfaces 'shiny'. Developers define finite catalog typed UI components; end users converse large language model composes, updates, removes instances components canvas schema-validated 'ellmer' tool calls, streamed progressively running app. model never emits code: arguments plain data validated catalog, guardrails hold construction.

title: shinygenui 0.1.0
text: Initial release: catalog-constrained generative UI Shiny. Define components genui_component() collect genui_catalog(); entry compiles schema-validated ellmer tool. genui_canvas() + genui_server() stream model-composed components running app, built-update_component, remove_component, clear_canvas, read-get_canvas_state lifecycle tools. Pure genui_dispatch() core validates plans every model-issued call; failures return model tool errors never crash session. genui_components_bslib() starter pack (value box, markdown card, data table, scatter plot, histogram embedded bin-count slider) genui_card_row() container. genui_trace() records every validated call; genui_replay() rebuilds canvas saved trace LLM configured.
